enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Seeker +1: Provides a +1 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +1 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Insightful Doublestrike 1%: Passive: 1% Insight bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Extra Smites 2: +2 Smite Evil uses per rest. Smite Evil uses regenerate 10% faster.
Charisma +4: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +4 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
